text: Being here, I feel a quiet curiosity. The sterile corridor gives way to a vibrantly designed exhibit, challenging my notion of what spaces for knowledge should be like. The "R+D" sign—Responsive and Rapidly Evolving Development—reminds me that learning never stagnates. My mind is alert, eager to engage with the ideas and questions that surround me. I sense the anticipation of discovery, mingling with the structured calm of this modern environment.
